invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Map, as it returns the result of context.mapToPair(), which should return a Map instance.
If there are no WriteStatuses, the distinguished partition path list to map is empty, so the result Map will be empty.
Each key in the result Map represents a distinct partition path from the WriteStatuses. Thus, the Map cannot have more keys than WriteStatuses.
The Map's keys correspond to the partition paths present in the WriteStatuses, specifically the distinct set of those paths.
Each value in the returned Map (a List of file ids) should be non-null, as it is initialized by getAllExistingFileIds().
